entities.title: NEM Flex Telemetry: HAEO entity mappings
entities.description: Map each telemetry field to a Home Assistant entity from your [HAEO]({haeo_docs}) installation. All entities must be sensor.* entities.

consent.title: NEM Flex Telemetry: Privacy and licence
consent.description:
Your data will be published under the [CC-BY-4.0 licence]({licence_url}). Only your postcode prefix (3 digits), NEM region, and the 12 telemetry fields are published. No NMI, no exact location, no appliance data.

See the [privacy statement]({privacy_url}) for full details.

data.licence_agreed: I agree to publish my telemetry data under CC-BY-4.0 (required)
